display_long_description:
FROM LISTENER TO CREATOR: YOUR PERSONAL SYMPHONY AWAITS

[media]

Forget passive meditation. Step beyond rhythm games. Welcome to Sound Bath by TRIPP, a revolutionary VR music experience where YOU are the composer, the DJ, and the artist. Immerse yourself in a transformative audiovisual journey designed to unlock your creativity and guide you to a state of deep relaxation.

CRAFT YOUR OWN SONIC MASTERPIECE

At the heart of this experience are incredible, interactive singing bowls. Each bowl is a unique instrument, a gateway to a different sonic texture and visual wonder:

Become an Interactive DJ: Mix and layer sounds in real-time, creating a generative music soundscape that is uniquely yours.

Build a Mind-Expanding Audiovisual Journey: Watch as your musical choices paint the world around you with breathtaking, reactive visuals.

Discover Your Flow State: Lose yourself in a seamless blend of sound, sight, and interaction designed for ultimate focus and calm.

A WORLD-CLASS STUDIO AT YOUR FINGERTIPS

This unparalleled music creation experience was born from a collaboration with the award-winning team at TRIPP and a curated lineup of world-renowned musical artists:

Tiësto & 7 Skies

David Starfire

Liquid Bloom

Cloudchord

Whether you seek boundless creativity, a powerful tool for mindfulness, or simply the ultimate immersive music sandbox, your personal symphony for the soul is here.
